IsAllowed.issue: MECHANISM: RelicModel.IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest (RelicModel.cs:452-456) is `runState.TotalFloor < 41` in single-player, i.e. the relic stops spawning from the Act 3 treasure chest onward. The sim's Relic base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py) declares NO is_allowed member at all, and relic_pools.populate_relic_grab_bags shuffles the whole transcribed pool once at run init with no per-pull eligibility filter, so the relic stays pullable for the entire run. REACHABILITY (LIVE): the relic is in the transcribed shared pool, the sim tracks RunState.total_floor already (event gates use it), and runs reach floor 41. The observable is pool composition -- a late pull hands out a relic the game would have filtered, which also shifts every subsequent pull. CLUSTER (executed: py tools/audit/relic_probes.py sweep-isallowed): TWENTY ported relics override IsAllowed and SIXTEEN share this exact gate -- amethyst_aubergine, book_of_five_rings, bowler_hat, dragon_fruit, frozen_egg, girya, juzu_bracelet, lucky_fysh, meal_ticket, molten_egg, old_coin, planisphere, shovel, toxic_egg, white_beast_statue, white_star. One base-class member plus one filter in the pull path closes all sixteen; see .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md.

AfterCardChangedPiles.maps_to: no counterpart; Relic.after_card_added_to_deck (relics/base.py:208) is the hook it would map to, and the sim's port implements nothing at all
AfterCardChangedPiles.issue: MECHANISM: BookOfFiveRings.cs:67-83 counts every card that enters the owner's deck and heals HealVar(20m).BaseValue every CardsVar(5)th one (`CardsAdded++` then `CardsAddedSinceLastTrigger == 0`, i.e. a running modulo, not a per-combat counter). The sim registers the relic as a behaviourless stub whose docstring says 'deck edits happen between combats, so this is a no-op stub' -- and that premise is FALSE. RunState.add_card (run.py:544-556) runs `relic.after_card_added_to_deck(self, card)` over every relic in the run on every deck add, which is exactly the hook this port needs; the sim also has HP and CreatureCmd.heal. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py tools/audit/relic_probes.py batch2): with the relic held and the player at 50 HP, five run.add_card calls leave HP at 50 where C# reaches 70. The relic is Common in the transcribed shared grab bag (relic_pools.py:'RELIC.BOOK_OF_FIVE_RINGS') and card rewards add cards to the deck constantly. CLUSTER: this is one of 30 behaviourless relic ports whose dropped C# hooks all have a live sim dispatch site -- py tools/audit/relic_probes.py sweep-stub-premises, findings in .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md.

guards.what: N1: the counter is a RUNNING MODULO over the whole run (`CardsAdded % 5`), not a reset-to-zero counter
guards.issue: Recorded separately from the hook because a fix that stores 'cards since last heal' and zeroes it would drift from C# the moment anything else touches the counter, and because CardsAdded is a [SavedProperty] -- it survives a save/load, so it is genuinely run-scoped state. Carries AfterCardChangedPiles' LIVE label. The heal amount is HealVar(20m).BaseValue and the period is CardsVar(5), neither with an ascension branch.

guards.rationale: The owner check is the multiplayer filter (out of scope). The IsDead check guards a deck add resolving while the owner is dead, which in the sim can only happen between rooms, when the run is already over. Neither is a divergence the stub could be said to have got wrong -- but both belong in the fix.

guards.what: N3: the pile filter is `pile.Type == PileType.Deck`, so combat-pile moves do NOT count
guards.rationale: AfterCardChangedPiles fires for every pile transition in the game, including hand->discard during combat; only the Deck pile increments the counter. The sim's after_card_added_to_deck is already deck-only by construction (relics/base.py:208-210 documents it as 'AfterCardChangedPiles, filtered to a card entering the run's deck pile'), so the filter is free when the port is written. Recorded so the fix does not hang the counter off a combat hook.
